inputs.text: The “No Kings” organizers say 8 million people showed up across more than 3,300 events in all 50 states—but authorities have provided no official count, and even their own estimate is not a national mandate. They also claim turnout beat October’s protests by about one million people and 600 events, as if a bigger demonstration can undo an election. It can’t. People are free to protest, but governing authority comes through the ballot box, not through organizers’ crowd claims. A country needs respect for lawful institutions and orderly transitions, not the loudest political faction declaring itself the voice of everyone else.
